_note: Memsic MX2125 thermal 2-axis accelerometer. 4-pin: VCC, GND, XOUT, YOUT (PWM output: 100 Hz, 50% duty = 0g, 12.5%/g). The Arduino sketch's ((pulse/10)-500)*8 → mg formula inverts this exactly. Params: gx/gy in g (default 0/0 = flat). Terminal names match engine kind 'memsic2125' in bw-board src/devices/accelerometers.js.
